paper_title: Evidence for light-by-light scattering and searches for axion-like particles in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions at $\sqrt{s_\mathrm{NN}} =$ 5.02 TeV
notes: CMS sets 95% CL limits on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma (=1/Lambda) vs ALP mass over 5-90 GeV via gamma-gamma -> a -> gamma gamma in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions. Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton (Fig.7 shows g_agamma vs m_a). However, no numerical table or readable digitized values are provided in the text; the limit curves are only described qualitatively (best limits over 5-50 GeV for photon-only coupling). Cross-section limits given as ~1500-20 nb over 5-90 GeV (Fig.6) but no g_agamma values extractable. Not a DM haloscope, so no density assumption.
